Diese HTML-Datei in einen eigenen Ordner: Save this HTML file in its own folder under Documents and double-click to open it in Chrome, Edge or Safari. No internet connection is needed.
Nach Änderungen «Liste als Datei sichern: After making changes, choose ‘Save list to file’. The JSON file contains all listings and contact details.
Zum Wechsel auf einen anderen Computer b: To use another computer, take both files: this HTML app and the latest JSON backup. Then choose ‘Open list from file’.
HTML und Sicherung können auf einem USB-: Keep the HTML app and backup on a USB stick, external drive, restricted residents’ folder or in Proton Drive / iCloud Drive. Download both files completely before using them offline.
Die HTML-Datei selbst enthält keine neu: The HTML file itself does not contain newly added listings. Browser storage is only a local working copy and may be lost if browsing data is cleared.
Beim Öffnen einer Sicherung wird die akt: Opening a backup replaces the current list after confirmation. If there are existing listings, a backup download is offered first. Lists edited in parallel are not automatically merged.
Eine Person kann die Offline-Hauptliste: One person can maintain the main offline list. Use the shared online platform for simultaneous contributions from different flats. An online export can be opened here; offline changes are not automatically sent back.
